name: fullAttn
stmt: def fullAttn (p : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) : F
proof: ∑ i, p i • v i

name: sparseAttn
stmt: def sparseAttn (p : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (S : Finset ι) (Z : ℝ) : F
proof:
∑ i in S, (p i / Z) • v i

                      
                                                  

omit [NormedSpace ℝ F] in

name: sum_partition
stmt:
lemma sum_partition (f : ι → F) (S : Finset ι) :
    ∑ i, f i = ∑ i in S, f i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, f i
proof:
by
                              
  have hunion : (Finset.univ : Finset ι) = S ∪ (Finset.univ \ S) := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ S
    · simp [hi]
    · simp [hi]
  calc
    ∑ i, f i = ∑ i in S ∪ (Finset.univ \ S), f i := by rw [← hunion]
    _ = ∑ i in S, f i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, f i := by
      exact Finset.sum_union disjoint_sdiff_self_right

name: renorm_diff
stmt:
lemma renorm_diff (pᵢ Z : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ pᵢ) (hZ : 0 < Z) (hZle : Z ≤ 1) :
    |pᵢ - pᵢ / Z| = pᵢ * (1 - Z) / Z
proof:
by
                                       
  have hneg : pᵢ - pᵢ / Z = -(pᵢ * (1 - Z) / Z) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hZ]
    ring
  rw [hneg, abs_neg]
                                             
  have hge : 0 ≤ pᵢ * (1 - Z) / Z := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ 1 - Z := by linarith
    have hprod : 0 ≤ pᵢ * (1 - Z) := mul_nonneg hp h1
    exact div_nonneg hprod (le_of_lt hZ)
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hge]

name: dropped_mass_bound
stmt:
theorem dropped_mass_bound (p : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (S : Finset ι) (Z M : ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hsum : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hZ : Z = ∑ i in S, p i) (hZ0 : 0 < Z) (hZ1 : Z ≤ 1)
    (hV : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖fullAttn p v - sparseAttn p v S Z‖ ≤ 2 * M * (1 - Z)
proof:
by
          
  have hdiff : fullAttn p v - sparseAttn p v S Z =
      ∑ i in S, (p i - p i / Z) • v i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i := by
    unfold fullAttn sparseAttn
                                                                   
    calc
      (∑ i, p i • v i) - (∑ i in S, (p i / Z) • v i)
          = (∑ i in S, p i • v i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i) - (∑ i in S, (p i / Z) • v i) := by
                          
            rw [← sum_partition (fun i => p i • v i) S]
        _ = (∑ i in S, p i • v i - ∑ i in S, (p i / Z) • v i) + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i := by
                                               
            abel
        _ = ∑ i in S, (p i - p i / Z) • v i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i := by
                                                            
            rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            apply congrArg (fun x => x + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i)
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i hi
            rw [← sub_smul]
  rw [hdiff]
            
  calc
    ‖∑ i in S, (p i - p i / Z) • v i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i‖
        ≤ ‖∑ i in S, (p i - p i / Z) • v i‖ + ‖∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (∑ i in S, ‖(p i - p i / Z) • v i‖) + (∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, ‖p i • v i‖) := by
      exact add_le_add (norm_sum_le _ _) (norm_sum_le _ _)
    _ ≤ (∑ i in S, p i * (1 - Z) / Z * M) + (∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i * M) := by

name: posterior
doc: 后验分布：post_z = p_z / Σ_z p_z。
stmt: noncomputable def posterior (p : Fin k → ℝ) : Fin k → ℝ
proof: fun z => p z / ∑ z', p z'

name: elbo
doc: 证据下界（ELBO）：ELBO(p,q) = Σ_z q_z·(log p_z − log q_z)。
stmt: noncomputable def elbo (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ z, q z * (Real.log (p z) - Real.log (q z))

name: posterior_pos
stmt:
lemma posterior_pos [Nonempty (Fin k)] (p : Fin k → ℝ) (hp : ∀ z, 0 < p z) :
    ∀ z, 0 < posterior p z
proof:
by
  intro z
  unfold posterior
  exact div_pos (hp z) (Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hp i) Finset.univ_nonempty)

name: posterior_sum
stmt:
lemma posterior_sum [Nonempty (Fin k)] (p : Fin k → ℝ) (hp : ∀ z, 0 < p z) :
    ∑ z, posterior p z = 1
proof:
by
  have hS : (∑ z, p z) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hp i) Finset.univ_nonempty)
  unfold posterior
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, div_self hS]

name: elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl
stmt:
theorem elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl [Nonempty (Fin k)] (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ z, 0 < p z) (hq : ∀ z, 0 < q z) (hqs : ∑ z, q z = 1) :
    elbo p q = Real.log (∑ z, p z) - kl q (posterior p)
proof:
by
  have hSpos : 0 < ∑ z, p z := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hp i) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hSne : (∑ z, p z) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hSpos
  have hpost_pos : ∀ z, 0 < posterior p z := posterior_pos p hp
  have hpost_sum : ∑ z, posterior p z = 1 := posterior_sum p hp
               
  have hkl := kl_as_sum_log_ratio q (posterior p) hq hpost_pos
                                                
  have hratio : ∀ z, Real.log (q z / posterior p z)
      = Real.log (q z) - Real.log (p z) + Real.log (∑ z, p z) := by
    intro z
    have h1 : q z / posterior p z = (q z * (∑ z, p z)) / p z := by
      unfold posterior
      field_simp [ne_of_gt (hp z), hSne]
    rw [h1, Real.log_div (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (hq z)) hSne) (ne_of_gt (hp z)),
      Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (hq z)) hSne]
    ring
             
  have hsum : ∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z / posterior p z)
      = (∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z)) - (∑ z, q z * Real.log (p z))
        + (∑ z, q z) * Real.log (∑ z, p z) := by
    have hterm : ∀ z, q z * Real.log (q z / posterior p z)
        = (q z * Real.log (q z) - q z * Real.log (p z))
          + q z * Real.log (∑ z, p z) := by
      intro z
      rw [hratio z]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => hterm z), Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_mul]
  have helbo : elbo p q
      = (∑ z, q z * Real.log (p z)) - (∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z)) := by
    unfold elbo
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro z _
    ring
  r

name: elbo_gap_is_kl
stmt:
theorem elbo_gap_is_kl [Nonempty (Fin k)] (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ z, 0 < p z) (hq : ∀ z, 0 < q z) (hqs : ∑ z, q z = 1) :
    Real.log (∑ z, p z) - elbo p q = kl q (posterior p)
proof:
by
  have h := elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl p q hp hq hqs
  linarith

name: elbo_le_log_marginal
stmt:
theorem elbo_le_log_marginal [Nonempty (Fin k)] (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ z, 0 < p z) (hq : ∀ z, 0 < q z) (hqs : ∑ z, q z = 1) :
    elbo p q ≤ Real.log (∑ z, p z)
proof:
by
  have hpost_pos : ∀ z, 0 < posterior p z := posterior_pos p hp
  have hpost_sum : ∑ z, posterior p z = 1 := posterior_sum p hp
  have hkl : 0 ≤ kl q (posterior p) :=
    kl_nonneg q (posterior p) hq hqs hpost_pos hpost_sum
  have heq := elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl p q hp hq hqs
  linarith

name: elbo_tight_iff
stmt:
theorem elbo_tight_iff [Nonempty (Fin k)] (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ z, 0 < p z) (hq : ∀ z, 0 < q z) (hqs : ∑ z, q z = 1) :
    elbo p q = Real.log (∑ z, p z) ↔ q = posterior p
proof:
by
  have hpost_pos : ∀ z, 0 < posterior p z := posterior_pos p hp
  have hpost_sum : ∑ z, posterior p z = 1 := posterior_sum p hp
  have hz := kl_zero_iff_eq q (posterior p) hq hqs hpost_pos hpost_sum
  have hpost_eq : elbo p (posterior p) = Real.log (∑ z, p z) := by
    rw [elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl p (posterior p) hp hpost_pos hpost_sum,
      kl_eq_zero_of_eq (posterior p) (posterior p) rfl]
    ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply hz.mp
    linarith [elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl p q hp hq hqs]
  · intro h
    rw [h, hpost_eq]

name: em_posterior_optimal
stmt:
theorem em_posterior_optimal [Nonempty (Fin k)] (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ z, 0 < p z) (hq : ∀ z, 0 < q z) (hqs : ∑ z, q z = 1) :
    elbo p q ≤ elbo p (posterior p) ∧ (elbo p q = elbo p (posterior p) ↔ q = posterior p)
proof:
by
  have hpost_pos : ∀ z, 0 < posterior p z := posterior_pos p hp
  have hpost_sum : ∑ z, posterior p z = 1 := posterior_sum p hp
  have h1 : elbo p q ≤ Real.log (∑ z, p z) := elbo_le_log_marginal p q hp hq hqs
  have h2 : elbo p (posterior p) = Real.log (∑ z, p z) := by
    rw [elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl p (posterior p) hp hpost_pos hpost_sum,
      kl_eq_zero_of_eq (posterior p) (posterior p) rfl]
    ring
  constructor
  · rw [h2]; exact h1
  · rw [h2]
    exact elbo_tight_iff p q hp hq hqs

name: elbo_eq_sum_log_p_add_entropy
stmt:
theorem elbo_eq_sum_log_p_add_entropy (p q : Fin k → ℝ) :
    elbo p q = (∑ z, q z * Real.log (p z)) + entropy q
proof:
by
  have h1 : entropy q = -∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z) := rfl
  have h2 : ∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z) = -entropy q := by
    rw [h1]; ring
  have h3 : elbo p q
      = (∑ z, q z * Real.log (p z)) - (∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z)) := by
    unfold elbo
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro z _
    ring
  rw [h3, h2]
  ring

end Lattice

name: mix
doc: 混合分布：r_a = lam·p_a + (1−lam)·q_a（p、q 的凸组合）。
stmt: def mix {k : ℕ} (lam : ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : Fin k → ℝ
proof: fun a => lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a

name: mix_is_pmf
stmt:
theorem mix_is_pmf {k : ℕ} (lam : ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    (∀ a, 0 ≤ mix lam p q a) ∧ ∑ a, mix lam p q a = 1
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro a
    unfold mix
    exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hlam0 (hp0 a)) (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlam1) (hq0 a))
  · unfold mix
    calc
      (∑ a, (lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a))
          = (∑ a, lam * p a) + ∑ a, (1 - lam) * q a := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      _ = lam * (∑ a, p a) + (1 - lam) * (∑ a, q a) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = lam * 1 + (1 - lam) * 1 := by rw [hpsum, hqsum]
      _ = 1 := by ring

name: mix_pos
stmt:
lemma mix_pos {k : ℕ} (lam : ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) : ∀ a, 0 < mix lam p q a
proof:
by
  intro a
  unfold mix
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hlam0 with hlamz | hlamgt
  ·                 
    subst lam
    simpa using (hq0 a)
  ·                            
    have h1 : 0 < lam * p a := mul_pos hlamgt (hp0 a)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ (1 - lam) * q a := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlam1) (le_of_lt (hq0 a))
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (le_add_of_nonneg_right h2)

name: mix_pmf_strict
stmt:
lemma mix_pmf_strict {k : ℕ} (lam : ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    (∀ a, 0 < mix lam p q a) ∧ ∑ a, mix lam p q a = 1
proof:
by
  constructor
  · exact mix_pos lam p q hlam0 hlam1 hp0 hq0
  · exact (mix_is_pmf lam p q hlam0 hlam1 (fun a => le_of_lt (hp0 a)) hpsum
      (fun a => le_of_lt (hq0 a)) hqsum).2

name: entropy_mix_identity
stmt:
theorem entropy_mix_identity {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (lam : ℝ) :
    entropy (mix lam p q)
      = lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q
          + lam * kl p (mix lam p q) + (1 - lam) * kl q (mix lam p q)
proof:
by
  let r : Fin k → ℝ := mix lam p q
                                                                                                   
  have hsimple : lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q + lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r
      = lam * crossEntropy p r + (1 - lam) * crossEntropy q r := by
    unfold kl
    ring
                                         
  have hmain : entropy r = lam * crossEntropy p r + (1 - lam) * crossEntropy q r := by
                                  
    have hra : ∀ a, r a = lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a := by
      intro a
      rfl
                                                                      
    have hsum : (∑ a, r a * Real.log (r a))
        = lam * (∑ a, p a * Real.log (r a))
            + (1 - lam) * (∑ a, q a * Real.log (r a)) := by
      calc
        (∑ a, r a * Real.log (r a))
            = ∑ a, (lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a) * Real.log (r a) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro a ha
              rw [hra a]
        _ = ∑ a, (lam * (p a * Real.log (r a))
              + (1 - lam) * (q a * Real.log (r a))) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro a ha
              ring
        _ = (∑ a, lam * (p a * Real.log (r a)))
            + ∑ a, (1 - lam) * (q a * Real.log (r a)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = lam * (∑ a, p a * Real.log (r a))
            + (1 - lam) * (∑ a, q a * Real.log (r a)) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]

name: entropy_concave
stmt:
theorem entropy_concave {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (lam : ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q ≤ entropy (mix lam p q)
proof:
by
  let r : Fin k → ℝ := mix lam p q
  have hpmf : (∀ a, 0 < mix lam p q a) ∧ ∑ a, mix lam p q a = 1 :=
    mix_pmf_strict lam p q hlam0 hlam1 hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum
  have hr0 : ∀ a, 0 < r a := by
    intro a
    exact (hpmf.1) a
  have hrs : ∑ a, r a = 1 := hpmf.2
  have hklp : 0 ≤ kl p r := kl_nonneg p r hp0 hpsum hr0 hrs
  have hklq : 0 ≤ kl q r := kl_nonneg q r hq0 hqsum hr0 hrs
  have hident := entropy_mix_identity p q lam
  have hident' : entropy r =
      lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q + lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r := by
    simpa [r] using hident
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r := by
    exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hlam0 hklp) (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlam1) hklq)
  rw [hident']
  linarith

name: kl_pos_of_ne
stmt:
lemma kl_pos_of_ne {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) (hpq : p ≠ q) : 0 < kl p q
proof:
by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ kl p q := kl_nonneg p q hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum
  have hneq : kl p q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hpq ((kl_zero_iff_eq p q hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum).mp hz)
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hnonneg (Ne.symm hneq)

name: entropy_concavity_strict
stmt:
theorem entropy_concavity_strict {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (lam : ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hlam0 : 0 < lam) (hlam1 : lam < 1) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q < entropy (mix lam p q)
proof:
by
  let r : Fin k → ℝ := mix lam p q
  have hpmf : (∀ a, 0 < mix lam p q a) ∧ ∑ a, mix lam p q a = 1 :=
    mix_pmf_strict lam p q (le_of_lt hlam0) (le_of_lt hlam1) hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum
  have hr0 : ∀ a, 0 < r a := by
    intro a
    exact (hpmf.1) a
  have hrs : ∑ a, r a = 1 := hpmf.2
                                                                      
  have hpne_r : p ≠ r := by
    intro hpr
    apply hpq
    funext a
    have hpa : p a = r a := congrFun hpr a
    have hra : r a = lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a := by rfl
    have hmain : p a = lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a := by rwa [hra] at hpa
    have hmul : (1 - lam) * p a = (1 - lam) * q a := by
      calc
        (1 - lam) * p a = p a - lam * p a := by ring
        _ = (lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a) - lam * p a := by
              nth_rewrite 1 [hmain]
              rfl
        _ = (1 - lam) * q a := by ring
    have hsub : (1 - lam) * (p a - q a) = 0 := by
      rw [mul_sub, hmul, sub_self]
    rcases (mul_eq_zero.mp hsub) with h1 | hdiff
    · exfalso
      exact (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm (ne_of_lt hlam1))) h1
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff
  have hklp_pos : 0 < kl p r := kl_pos_of_ne p r hp0 hpsum hr0 hrs hpne_r
  have hklq_nonneg : 0 ≤ kl q r := kl_nonneg q r hq0 hqsum hr0 hrs
  have hident := entropy_mix_identity p q lam
  have hident' : entropy r =
      lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q + lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r := by
    simpa [r] using hident
  have hgt : 0 < lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r :

name: entropy_concavity_eq_iff
stmt:
theorem entropy_concavity_eq_iff {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (lam : ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    entropy (mix lam p q) = lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q
      ↔ lam = 0 ∨ lam = 1 ∨ p = q
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    by_cases h0 : lam = 0
    · exact Or.inl h0
    · right
      by_cases h1 : lam = 1
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · right
                      
        have hlamgt : 0 < lam := lt_of_le_of_ne hlam0 (by intro hz; exact h0 hz.symm)
        have hlamlt : lam < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hlam1 h1
        let r : Fin k → ℝ := mix lam p q
        have hpmf : (∀ a, 0 < mix lam p q a) ∧ ∑ a, mix lam p q a = 1 :=
          mix_pmf_strict lam p q (le_of_lt hlamgt) (le_of_lt hlamlt) hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum
        have hr0 : ∀ a, 0 < r a := by
          intro a
          exact (hpmf.1) a
        have hrs : ∑ a, r a = 1 := hpmf.2
        have hident := entropy_mix_identity p q lam
        have hident' : entropy r =
            lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q + lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r := by
          simpa [r] using hident
        have h : entropy r = lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q := by
          simpa [r] using heq
                                                 
        have hdiff : lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r = 0 := by
          rw [hident'] at h
          linarith
        have hklp0 : 0 ≤ kl p r := kl_nonneg p r hp0 hpsum hr0 hrs
        have hklq0 : 0 ≤ kl q r := kl_nonneg q r hq0 hqsum hr0 hrs
                           
        have hterm1 : lam * kl p r = 0 := by
          have hle1 : lam * kl p r ≤ lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r :=
            le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hlamlt)) hklq0
